law.catch_line: Acquisition of security or financial asset or interest therein

text.section:
A person acquires a security or an interest therein, under this title, if:
the person is a purchaser to whom a security is delivered pursuant to § 8.8A-301; or
the person acquires a security entitlement to the security pursuant to § 8.8A-501.
A person acquires a financial asset, other than a security, or an interest therein, under this title, if the person acquires a security entitlement to the financial asset.

A person who acquires a security entitlement to a security or other financial asset has the rights specified in Part 5, but is a purchaser of any security, security entitlement, or other financial asset held by the securities intermediary only to the extent provided in § 8.8A-503.

Unless the context shows that a different meaning is intended, a person who is required by other law, regulation, rule, or agreement to transfer, deliver, present, surrender, exchange, or otherwise put in the possession of another person a security or financial asset satisfies that requirement by causing the other person to acquire an interest in the security or financial asset pursuant to subsection (a) or (b).
